//go:build fts5 && (sqlcipher || libsqlcipher)

package model

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"github.com/88250/lute/parse"
	"github.com/siyuan-note/siyuan/kernel/conf"
	"github.com/siyuan-note/siyuan/kernel/sql"
	"github.com/siyuan-note/siyuan/kernel/util"
)

func TestGenerateStructuredTitlesLegacyFixture(t *testing.T) {
	destination := os.Getenv("SIYUAN_LEGACY_FIXTURE_DESTINATION")
	if destination == "" {
		t.Fatal("fixture destination is required")
	}
	prepareHPathRefreshTest(t)
	t.Cleanup(backgroundRefreshWaitGroup.Wait)
	Conf.Flashcard.Store(conf.NewFlashcard())
	const password = "legacy-title-fixture-password"
	if err := EnableEncryptedNotebook(password); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	normal := &Box{ID: "20261022000000-normal1"}
	boxConf := conf.NewBoxConf()
	boxConf.Name, boxConf.Closed = "Legacy title fixture", false
	if err := normal.SaveConf(boxConf); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	plain := newHPathTestDoc(t, normal.ID, "/", "Legacy ordinary", 2)
	plainChild := newHPathTestDoc(t, normal.ID, plain.Path, "Literal ／ %2F **text** 😀", 2)
	encrypted, err := CreateEncryptedBox("Legacy encrypted fixture", password)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if _, err = Mount(encrypted); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	private := newHPathTestDoc(t, encrypted, "/", "Private legacy", 2)
	privateChild := newHPathTestDoc(t, encrypted, private.Path, "Private literal ／ %2F 😀", 2)
	sql.FlushQueue()
	drainHPathRefreshTest(t)
	type document struct {
		Notebook  string `json:"notebook"`
		ID        string `json:"id"`
		ParentID  string `json:"parentID"`
		Path      string `json:"path"`
		Title     string `json:"title"`
		Encrypted bool   `json:"encrypted"`
	}
	documents := []document{}
	for _, tree := range []*parse.Tree{plain, plainChild, private, privateChild} {
		parent := ""
		directory := filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Dir(tree.Path))
		if directory != "/" && directory != "." {
			parent = filepath.Base(directory)
		}
		documents = append(documents, document{tree.Box, tree.ID, parent, tree.Path,
			tree.Root.IALAttr("title"), tree.Box == encrypted})
		if strings.Contains(tree.Root.IALAttr("title"), "/") {
			t.Fatal("legacy title contains a slash")
		}
		if tree.Root.Spec != "2" {
			t.Fatalf("unexpected legacy specification: %s", tree.Root.Spec)
		}
	}
	LockBox(encrypted)
	if err = os.CopyFS(filepath.Join(destination, "data"), os.DirFS(util.DataDir)); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	write := func(name string, value any) {
		t.Helper()
		data, err := json.MarshalIndent(value, "", "  ")
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if err = os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(destination, name), data, 0600); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
	write("notebook-crypto.json", currentNotebookCrypto())
	write("manifest.json", map[string]any{"tag": "v3.8.9-alpha.4", "commit": os.Getenv("SIYUAN_LEGACY_FIXTURE_COMMIT"),
		"password": password, "documents": documents})
}
